subject: Insufficient memory space for an object using function predict

messages.author: fdaa54d30ab7b913
messages.subject: Insufficient memory space for an object using function predict
parts:
Dear list members.

I am trying to do a map of a species occurrence and got a message of insufficient memory space (I think).

> espacial = predict(mod11e500, type="state", newdata = dist_df, appendData=TRUE)
Error: cannot allocate vector of size 5.6 Gb
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In .local(obj, coefficients, ...) :
  Reached total allocation of 3959Mb: see help(memory.size)
2: In .local(obj, coefficients, ...) :
  Reached total allocation of 3959Mb: see help(memory.size)
3: In .local(obj, coefficients, ...) :
  Reached total allocation of 3959Mb: see help(memory.size)
4: In .local(obj, coefficients, ...) :
  Reached total allocation of 3959Mb: see help(memory.size)

Is there any solution to this problem?

Best.

Manuel

messages.author: 681fb59733e01a1e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Insufficient memory space for an object using function predict
parts:
Dear Manuel,
 yea this is a known bug -- the function has to do a  matrix inversaion of size n x n (n = number of pts to predict on) so , naturally, this operation is limited by your computers memory.
 the only thing you can do now is make the predictions the hard way -- but extracting the coefficients and multiplying the design matrix, etc..
regards
andy
